API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIReportsGets the list of all active web probes on a device
Gets the list of all active web probes on a device
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/apps/:appid/web-probes

Gets the list of all active web probes on a device. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

appid
integer
REQUIRED

The application ID assigned by ZDX. For example, 12 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality.

Example: 12
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
Example
SCHEMA
Array [
id
integer

The web probe ID.

name
string

The web probe name.

num_probes
integer

The number of probes.

avg_score
integer

The average score.

avg_pft
integer

The average page fetch time in milliseconds.

]
